subject: Workspace activation & invite timeline — next steps for BlueGrid
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@bluegrid.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: BlueGrid - kickoff & initial workspace details

Evelyn / Marissa —

Thanks for taking this one. BlueGrid (Sara Jensen) signed the Dedicated contract last week and asked for an accelerated activation. Key items we agreed in the SOW: a single production workspace, API key-based access for service accounts, and SSO (SAML) integration later in the rollout.

Quick context:
- Account: BlueGrid Systems (deal BG-2027-148)
- Target go-live (warm traffic): 2027-05-10
- Initial usage: ~2 V100-equivalent GPUs steady, spiky bursts for nightly jobs
- Compliance: SOC2 in procurement notes; they requested audit-log retention options

Attached: internal kickoff checklist (RGD-Kickoff-Checklist.pdf) with our recommended timeline.

Next steps I propose for this thread:
1) Evelyn — confirm kickoff slot and owner for org creation + invites.
2) Dev (cc'd later) — prepare service-account template + sample API key rotation notes.
3) Sara — share names/emails for initial admin invites and SSO metadata if ready.

Thanks — I can join the first call if helpful.

—Karthik
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Handoff: BlueGrid - kickoff & initial workspace details

Hi Sara —

Welcome — excited to partner on the rollout. I'm owning the implementation and will run the kickoff. Proposed agenda (30-45m):
- Quick introductions + scope confirmation (5m)
- Org/workspace creation & naming conventions (5m)
- Access model: admin vs. dev vs. service accounts (10m)
- API key provisioning & rotation plan (10m)
- Next steps & timeline (5-15m)

Can you confirm the three people to be created as initial admins? We need names + emails for invites and RBAC mapping. Also: do you have SAML metadata or an IdP contact? If not, we'll proceed with API keys and add SSO later.

Action items for our side:
- Dev will post the service-account template and a sample API-key rotation cadence.
- We'll create the workspace and send admin invites; you can accept and confirm access.

Proposed kickoff slots (PDT): Thu 4/22 09:00 — 09:45, Thu 4/22 13:00 — 13:45, or Fri 4/23 10:00 — 10:45. Which works best?

Attaching the internal checklist for reference and a short service-account template (service-account-templates.txt).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

- Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@bluegrid.com> (Primary)

- Priya Nambiar <priya.n@bluegrid.com> (Platform engineer)

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Attachments: bluegrid_sso_metadata.xml
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@bluegrid.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: BlueGrid - kickoff & initial workspace details

Hi all —

Thanks for the details, Sara. I've prepped the service-account recipe and the API key flow we'll use. Summary below and attached full template.

Service account: bluegrid-ci (scoped to workspace: bluegrid-prod)
- Principle: short-lived API keys (rotate daily) for CI; long-lived keys are disabled by policy.
- Permissions: generate_tokens, read_embeddings, infer_text (least privilege for batch jobs).
- Recommended rotation: place a scheduler to request a new key 30 minutes before expiration; keys expire 24 hours.

Provisioning steps I'll run after kickoff acceptance:
1) Create workspace: bluegrid-prod
2) Create roles and map admin/dev/service accounts
3) Create service account bluegrid-ci and post initial API key to the secure channel (we will not email keys).
4) Send admin invites to Sara / Tom / Priya with one-click accept links.

Attachments: service-account-templates.txt (includes sample CLI commands and a short script).

If you want, I can also seed a Cloud IAM policy snippet for your infra team to mirror on their side.

—Dev
Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference

All set for 13:00 PDT. We'll be on the call from BlueGrid's office (Tom will share a dial-in). We've accepted the drive folder invite and see the checklist. We'll not accept API keys by email — please post initial secret to our secure vault (we use HashiCorp Vault) or share via the secure channel you mentioned.

Looking forward to the kickoff and the pre-seeding of SSO metadata.

—Sara
